action_instruction: Checking the stated benefits in the Your perks list
intent: whether the Your perks list contains all four stated membership benefits

action_params.condition: "Your perks" lists "Loyalty badge next to your name", "Custom emoji in chat", "Members-only posts" and "Early access to videos".
action_params.query: whether the Your perks list contains all four stated membership benefits
action_params.code_js: [el(8), el(9), el(10), el(11)].every((node, i) => node && node.innerText.trim().includes(['Loyalty badge next to your name','Custom emoji in chat','Members-only posts','Early access to videos'][i]))
locators: internal:text="✓ Loyalty badge next to your"i

assertion_tree.description: "Your perks" lists "Loyalty badge next to your name", "Custom emoji in chat", "Members-only posts" and "Early access to videos", and billing "$4.99/month · Visa •••• 4242".

sub_results.description: "Your perks" lists "Loyalty badge next to your name", "Custom emoji in chat", "Members-only posts" and "Early access to videos".

assertion_tree.verification: The current page shows the specified "Your perks" items and billing information.
